description: Repairs r-dao-1b/db-members-accdb, tabledef-members-each, recordset-members-*, field-members-typed-each, recordset-fields-members-each: the fixture was opened read-only, so every Updatable and DataUpdatable read (all 0) could not be attributed to ACE. On a writable Database: Database.Updatable; every TableDef (at most 32) Name and Updatable; every QueryDef (at most 16) Name and Updatable; for a table-type, a dynaset, a snapshot and a forward-only recordset on Parent: Updatable, LockEdits, and every Field's Name and DataUpdatable; a dynaset on Parent opened with LockEdits 2 and with 3 (the fourth argument): Updatable and LockEdits; a snapshot through QueryDef QUnion: Updatable and every Field's DataUpdatable; every Field of TableDef Typed: Name and DataUpdatable. Nothing is written. Asks Updatable, DataUpdatable and LockEdits on a writable open, where the original read them on a read-only one. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
